maria: Quick brief / webinar April 7 — need X + LinkedIn micro-schedule, 2 hero variants (landscape + square), 1-line hook, and SDR routing plan. Also want two tiny follow-up DMs for commenters. :calendar:

sam: I'll write a punchy hook + an alt hook for A/B and 3 thread openers by EOD.

jess: Creative can do hero_land.png and hero_square.png + a 2-frame GIF showing routing fallback. ETA Mon noon. If late, we use text-only fallback.

leo: Routing: require UTMs on all links. Suggest utm_medium=social, utm_source=x_or_li, utm_campaign=apr7_webinar, utm_content={variant}. SDR label = social_webinar.

sdr-triage: Confirm. We'll auto-tag and escalate anyone with >1 engagement to SDR. Share intake fields and DM templates here when ready.

maria: Proposed micro-schedule (org account):
- Apr 1 09:00 PT: teaser (X + LI)
- Apr 3 11:00 PT: deep thread (X)
- Apr 6 10:00 PT: reminder (X + LI)
- Apr 7 09:00 PT: live push (X)
Post-event Apr 8: highlight thread + on-demand link.

sam: Short hooks:
- Variant A: "Lower inference cost. Faster responses."
- Variant B: "Resilient inference at scale."
I'll shorten for X opener and add LI blurb.

jess: I'll upload assets to Drive + Figma and paste links here. Include alt text.

ops-bot: @frontend-team please add marketing pixel flag to webinar reg page. Ticket WEB-3421.

leo: I'll validate UTM ingestion in CRM Wed and confirm webhooks.

sdr-triage: DM templates coming Wed: 1) commenter -> on-demand, 2) heavy-engager -> SDR outreach.

maria: Final checklist: assets, hooks A/B, scheduler entries with UTMs, SDR snippets, DM templates. React with :white_check_mark: when done.

sam: ✅

jess: ✅ (uploading shortly)

leo: ✅

maria: I'll assemble the micro-playbook and loop in growth for a tiny boost budget. :rocket:
